firstMessage.content:
We are sharing our experiment code and technical retrospective: https://github.com/cylovelife/kaggle-winner

The report covers prompt-grouped validation, text-only stylistic features, external-data admission, sparse baselines, neural experiments and runtime limits. Our recorded best Public score is 0.378; this is not a top solution. The local holdout remains sealed. The repository excludes competition data, model weights, predictions and credentials. Negative results and limitations are documented alongside improvements.
